_about: Batch B8a (Config + start-up): concepts/config-system, code/engine-arg-utils, code/config-vllm, code/envs, tours/serve-startup. Owner: the B8a writer.

config-decorator.short: The decorator in vllm/config/utils.py that makes a config class a pydantic dataclass whose settings forbid unknown fields.
config-decorator.long: Defined at {{cite vllm/config/utils.py:51-82}}; extra="forbid" at {{cite vllm/config/utils.py:71}}.

engine-args.short: One flat dataclass with a field for each engine flag. vllm serve fills it from the parsed command line, then calls create_engine_config() on it.
engine-args.long: Class at {{cite vllm/engine/arg_utils.py:482-483}}; AsyncEngineArgs adds one flag ({{cite vllm/engine/arg_utils.py:3230-3235}}).

create-engine-config.short: The EngineArgs method that builds every sub-config in a fixed order, fills the None defaults, and returns one VllmConfig.

usage-context.short: A UsageContext enum value that tells create_engine_config() who starts the engine. vllm serve passes OPENAI_API_SERVER; the token budget defaults depend on it.
usage-context.long: Enum at {{cite vllm/usage/usage_lib.py:111-117}}; used for defaults at {{cite vllm/engine/arg_utils.py:3159-3168}}.

post-init.short: The method that a dataclass runs right after its __init__. VllmConfig uses it to check the sub-configs together and to set many late defaults.

env-cache.short: The functools.cache that enable_envs_cache() puts around envs.__getattr__. After it, envs.X returns a stored value. Only the engine core and the worker processes of the multiprocessing executor turn it on.

startup-handshake.short: The HELLO, init message and READY exchange between a new engine core process and the front end on a ZMQ socket.
startup-handshake.long: Engine side {{cite vllm/v1/engine/core.py:1364-1413}}; front-end side {{cite vllm/v1/engine/utils.py:1398-1591}}.
